result_kind: simulated (behavioural model B with T-extracted corner parameters compared against the 4096-clock transistor-level transient; DR-001 item 3 as amended by DR-001 corrigendum 01)
method_basis: spec/decisions/DR-001-evidence-split.md item 3, as amended by spec/decisions/DR-001-corrigendum-01.md (issue #290); T side sim/modulator-tran record-long.json + samples-long/

acceptance_gates.sndr_inband_3db: |SNDR_inband_B - SNDR_inband_T| <= 3.0 dB -- DR-001's tolerance verbatim, on the lobe-summed signal / in-band noise estimator of spec sec 1.2, both sides over the same 4096-clock window
acceptance_gates.reported_not_gating: in-band power agreement (the first record's computable ancestor of this leg) and out-of-band noise power stay reported as auxiliary diagnostics; the operator ruling declined them as the closing leg (options b/c)

dr001_acceptance: computed per corner: the corrigendum's 4096-clock record leaves in-band noise bins beside the tone lobe, so item 3's SNDR-vs-SNDR gate is applied as written (3 dB, unchanged). A corner that passes is cross-checked under the corrigendum (proposed until ratified: two reviews, then the operator); a corner that fails is a model finding, not a relaxation. The committed 1024-clock record (xcheck-record.json) and its incomplete-at-every-corner statement are untouched append-only evidence.
corrigendum_length_evidence: N_T = 4096 recorded clocks: probe run 1104.6 s (one corner, tt/27 C/1.80 V, fleet job klt-sim-56a43a043984) against the fleet's 3600 s whole-job ceiling; 8192 clocks extrapolate past it at every measured per-clock rate. spec/decisions/DR-001-corrigendum-01.md holds the full arithmetic.

corners.amplitude_note: the T bench drove spec row 11's 0.5*VREF (-6 dBFS nominal); the committed u_diff_v is the analytic tone sample values

sndr_inband_db.estimator: lobe-summed signal / in-band noise, no ENBW (sum(w^2) cancels in the ratio; issue #107), spec sec 1.2's estimator

inband_power_fs_norm.role: reported proxy; declined as a gating leg by the operator ruling (options b/c)

out_of_band_noise_power.note: auxiliary gross-mismatch detector; not a DR-001 leg

sample_wise_reported_not_gated.why_not_gated: a single-bit loop is chaotic; B and T decorrelate sample-wise within a few clocks whatever the model's quality (sim/modulator-tran/README.md), so these metrics measure the chaos, not the model

sndr_inband_3db.what: DR-001 item 3 (corrigendum 01): in-band SNDR of B over T, same 4096-clock window, same 4-term Blackman-Harris window; signal = tone-lobe sum bins 8..16, noise = the 7 in-band noise bins beside it; 3 dB, unchanged

corners.cross_check_status: failed at this corner: the in-band SNDR leg of DR-001 item 3 is computable at the corrigendum's 4096-clock record and disagrees beyond 3 dB; FAILED legs: sndr_inband_3db, span_10pct. A failing leg is a model finding, not a relaxation (DR-001 item 3); model B numbers at this corner stay uncross-checked and are not used for row 2.
